about: The baseline at scale (R10.24): today's world server (refactor/scale on refactor/first, before the tiers, the wire, borders and channels) on the Windows machine (i9-14900HX, 32 threads, RTX 4090 laptop GPU), shared with eight other workstreams. loadtest: crates/tools/src/bin/loadtest.rs (each point the median of three repetitions on a fresh server). browser: tests/stress/battlefield.spec.ts. bench: the tick-time bench (cargo test --release -p ruina-server tick_time -- --ignored --nocapture), the rules and one admin's update without sockets. Explained in scale.md beside this file. npm run loadtest -- --compare .plans/refactor/reports/scale-baseline.json puts a new run beside it.
